content: tldraw: package-per-concern split (@tldraw/editor, store, state, tlschema, validate) with the editor package re-exporting. Extensibility comes from an abstract ShapeUtil class: static type, static props, static migrations, plus component, getGeometry, getIndicatorPath and many interaction hooks. Registration is an array prop: shapeUtils={[CardShapeUtil]}. ShapeUtil.configure() customizes a built-in shape without subclassing, which is a cheap in-place customization path. Note tldraw validates with its own T validators rather than zod because validation runs per store record on every write.
